title: Lead first name and customer contact details

rulings: email change keeps the card (opt-in confirmation email)

fixtures.murphy-leads: Four Murphy leads (murphy-lead-1 to 4); murphy-lead-3 has no first name, a phone ending 0142 and no linked customer; murphy-lead-4 also has no first name but is linked to a customer; leads 1 and 2 have first names. Three Murphy customers (cust-murphy-a, b, c) with distinct phones.
fixtures.murphy-customers: cust-murphy-a (phone ending 0111, email on file, a pending newsletter opt-in row for that email) and cust-murphy-b (phone ending 0222, a pending newsletter opt-in row for its email), same street name different numbers.
fixtures.lead-single: One lead, lead-ostrander, with a last name only.

required_corrections.W3-C1: canonical Murphy lead first-name case, owner-direct, four Murphy leads and no page context: pick the one fitting unlinked lead or ask one question listing candidates; never refuse, never say tools are erroring
required_corrections.W3-C2: wrong one, the one with phone ending 0142 (new operation, new receipt, first change left in place and reported)
required_corrections.W3-C3: change their email to x (card appears, disclosure names the opt-in email)
